ledger.note: Rechecked the Kinder Morgan project page, the Georgia, Alabama, and South Carolina trade press, and news on shippers. The project page never mentions data centers and names no plants. Kinder Morgan talks about data center demand across its whole business, but not for this expansion. No named Southern Company plant tied to data center load was found.

Rechecked project materials and press. Duke Energy and Enbridge Gas North Carolina are the shippers, and Duke cites coal retirements and load growth. No named plant was found, and no source ties Southgate or a Duke plant it serves to data center load.

Rechecked press on the Northeast Supply Enhancement project. The only data center talk comes from opponents, who argue gas build-out is tied to data centers. A trade article about Williams data center power projects does not tie them to this project. National Grid cites reliability and utility demand. No named plant or customer was found.

Rechecked Phase III coverage. It is a compressor addition for Florida Power and Light and Duke Energy Florida. Data center talk found is from advocacy groups about a separate newer Sabal Trail expansion. No source ties Phase III or a plant it serves to data center load.
